summary: Sunday's late games are final: Heat won 114-108 in Sacramento and the Clippers beat the Pelicans 139-123 to end a 7-game skid. Tonight's 8-game slate starts at 8:00 am Tue MYT. The big story is Denver: Jokic, Murray, Braun, Gordon, Cam Johnson and DeRozan are all questionable at Houston after travel delays from Mexico City, and Luka Doncic (back) is questionable for the Lakers on a back-to-back at Atlanta. No pick right now - prices look fair; the Nuggets and Lakers news (about 30-60 min before tip) is what to watch.
